purpose: Freeze official IGP evidence that Huaycoloro and Río Seco are distinct monitored local components whose channels join in the Radio Observatorio de Jicamarca area, while preserving the exact junction/outlet and all collector-routing parameters as unresolved. Also preserve one bounded IGP field observation from 2017 without converting it into a transferable IRFEN routing parameter or threshold.

sources.bounded_observation: IGP describes the ROJ area as the zone where the channels of Río Seco and Huaycoloro join and states that flow-detection instrumentation was deployed in both ravines. The reported 31-Jan-2017 flow passage was first registered at 16:04 local time.

IGP reports observation of a new alluvial flow at Puente Petramás, approximately 8 km upstream of Carretera Ramiro Prialé, with an estimated discharge of 72.5 m3/s and a reported 4-minute arrival time from the monitoring-system point to the settlement/bridge observation point.

event_observations.reported_relative_position: approximately 8 km upstream of Carretera Ramiro Prialé
event_observations.segment_origin: SAT monitoring point; exact station identity/coordinate unresolved in this source
event_observations.segment_destination: Saracoto/Puente Petramás observation point; exact coordinate unresolved in this source
